name: docdock
description: Autohide sidebar for viewing, adding, and editing references

scripts.check: pnpm --silent check:fast && pnpm --silent test && pnpm --silent check:rust
scripts.check:fast: biome check . && node scripts/check-colors.mjs && pnpm --silent check:types && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check
scripts.check:rust: cargo clippy -q --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -q --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
